text:
jordan: Quick sync — consolidating follow-ups across recent GPU surge postmortems. I opened a single backlog item to avoid duplicate work. TL;DR: quota requests, scheduler tuning, and headroom targets need owners and dates.

sana: can you drop the backlog link? I missed the PRD.

jordan: https://rwd.internal/infra/incident-backlog/GPUSurge-2026 - put your initials next to items you own.

sana: taking quota request to cloud-sales. will confirm required vCPU+GPU numbers by EOD Fri. @lee can you validate the traffic forecast?

lee: will validate. rough numbers: 2.5x normal peak for 3h/day, plus unpredictable spikes. assuming 2-week runway.

marta: main action from postmortem — sched needs better headroom calc. current headroom set to fixed 8% which failed under bursty churn.

lee: agreed. propose switching to a percentile-based headroom from live latency distribution. less brittle.

sana: cloud quota asks need exact gpu types + zones. I can request A100s in us-west-2 but we should list compatible quantized variants too.

jordan: owner matrix proposal: quota -> sana, scheduler tuning -> lee, headroom runbook + monitoring -> marta. ops-bot: please create sub-tasks in the incident tracker.

ops-bot: Created tasks: #7421 (quota request), #7422 (scheduler tuning), #7423 (headroom runbook). Assigned: sana, lee, marta. ETA placeholders requested.

marta: for scheduler tuning I'll start with a small config patch to change the scaling algorithm and add a safety backoff. draft config below: 
```
scaler:
  algorithm: percentile
  percentile_window: 600  # seconds
  percentile_target: 95
  headroom_mode: dynamic
  headroom_min_pct: 10
  headroom_max_pct: 30
  scale_down_delay: 300
```

lee: that looks good. let's also limit max-burst to avoid rapid preemption: max_burst: 2.

sana: timeline check — I can submit quota request tomorrow, cloud usually replies within 48-72h. We should mark this blocked until quota approval.

jordan: agreed. put blockers on #7421 and tag "quota-critical". Also add fallback policy: if quota delayed, route non-critical traffic to CPU-quantized models and reduce batch sizes.

marta: monitoring additions: add a gauge for available GPU headroom, and an alert when effective headroom < 12% for 10m. Also an anomaly alert for sustained pod churn > 5/min.

lee: I'll add the alert rules in the prometheus repo and create a small dashboard. ETA: PR by Tue.

sana: putting owner ETA on tracker: quota request submitted by Mon, follow-up by Wed.

jordan: ownership confirmations noted. Two follow-ups: 1) weekly 15-min check on the tracker until quotas land, 2) retro in two weeks to validate changes prevented recurrence. Can we make the weekly check recurring? ops-bot?

ops-bot: Recurring 15-min check created on Tuesdays at 10:00 for 4 weeks. Added calendar invites to participants.

marta: one more: we should capture a minimal runbook snippet to use during a surge: short checklist with immediate mitigation steps. I'll draft and push to docs.

lee: sample mitigation checklist: 1) enable CPU fallback route, 2) reduce generation length to 50%, 3) enable aggressive KV cache, 4) scale up reserved pool if quota allows. Keep it < 8 steps.

jordan: perfect. last ask — everyone add a 1-line verification test for their PRs so we can run a quick smoke after deploys.

sana: will do.

lee: PR for scheduler + alerts by Tue.

marta: runbook draft by Wed.

jordan: thanks all. closing thread — we will track progress in #7421-#7423 and check in on Tues recurring meeting. :thumbsup:
